summary: Acura Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing additional loans totaling $400,000 from Abuse Deterrent Pharma, LLC (AD Pharma) in May and June 2026, increasing the principal balance under the secured promissory note to $10.7 million with ~$1.16 million in accrued interest at 5.25%. The funds support day-to-day operations; the filing warns that without additional financing by late July 2026, the company may scale back operations or seek bankruptcy protection, potentially resulting in a total loss of shareholder value. This is a routine going-concern disclosure, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, or strategic restructuring is announced.
